implementation_summary: Added the Hindi label table (hi.ts) with every key of en.ts, in Devanagari, NFC, with no nukta letters; only AI, WCAG 2.2 AA and robots.txt stay in English letters and {n} is kept. Registered it in labels/index.ts and added DocumentTextKey (dotted paths of DocumentLabels), documentText(language, key, vars?), documentDirection(language) from DOCUMENT_LANGUAGE_INFO.dir, and betaLabel(language), which returns the table's status.betaTranslation for beta languages and '' otherwise. documentText throws, naming the language, when there is no table, and also throws for a missing key or a missing {variable}; it never falls back to English and only reads the table's own properties. labelsFor keeps its English fallback for existing callers. Per the merge note there is no document-text.ts and no locales/ folder.
